action_items: (Minor) /dashboard/cvtheque: avatar is rendered with src="" when no avatar; replace with null/undefined or render fallback initials instead to silence React warning.

(Minor) Review 404s on /dashboard/profil (EDUCATOR) and /dashboard/reservations (PARENT) — endpoints returning 404 probably triggered by a sub-fetch (feedback/reviews or legacy bookings). Investigate and either catch the 404 silently or ship the endpoint.

(Doc) The learner save path uses PUT /api/users/me/profile, not /api/users/me/learner as described in the review request. If a dedicated endpoint is intended, add it; otherwise update the spec/review wording.
critical_code_review_comments: tailwind.config.js remaps violet/purple/fuchsia/sky/cyan/teal/indigo ALL to the askool blue scale. This is a one-way visual lockdown — great for enforcing the palette, but any future developer who adds <... className='text-purple-600'> expecting a true purple will silently get blue. Consider leaving a code-level comment and lint rule, since the mapping is now invisible from the component source.

Same for yellow/amber -> orange: a 'yellow warning' badge anywhere in the codebase now renders as orange, which could visually collide with action/accent orange. Status badges in SchoolNews.jsx (CAT_COLORS), EnrollmentRequests.jsx, Applications.jsx, Bookings.jsx should be audited to make sure 'warning' and 'success' states remain visually distinguishable (user explicitly asked to keep discrete green/red for status badges — verify green classes aren't being swallowed by the remap).

grayScale 300/400/500 all collapse to #7b849c (TEXT_MUTED). Any legacy border-gray-300 is now the same color as text-gray-500 (muted text), which may remove visible separators from older cards. The askool-card component uses --askool-blue-pale (good), but ad-hoc border-gray-200/300 across the codebase should be grep'd and migrated.

LearnerProfile.jsx (142 LOC, dense) renders fine but mixes 2 sub-components (ActionCard, Act) inline and declares ActionCard between imports — unusual, triggers linter warnings and makes diffs noisy. Split into /components/learner/*.

LearnerProfile edit: on save, api.put('/users/me/profile', {... city: f.location || user?.city}) overwrites user.city with the selected 'location' region even when the user had a more specific city — potential data loss. Consider keeping city and location as distinct fields.

index.css @media (prefers-reduced-motion) sets transition-duration: 0.001ms !important globally; this breaks the dialog/popover open/close animations Radix relies on for state transitions in some edge cases. OK for a11y but verify Radix portals still unmount cleanly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 4 role dashboards, 10 public routes, learner CRUD, mobile layout verified

rca of the issue: No regression bugs found. 404 noise on educator/profil and parent/reservations appears to be legacy data-fetch endpoints that return 404 for users with no related records; the UI handles them gracefully (page renders).
